label: Effect-grounded productive modes are excluded by strict explanatory priority
description: Applies existing PriorityOmission.constitutionNotPriorOfWholeFirst in the SAME fact relation. The causal-to-fact bridge and relevance are explicit. This is not a proof that every extrinsic distinction is effect-grounded, nor a restatement of the recognition bridge: no apprehension predicate occurs. Its value is a conditional exclusion that binds personal effect-grounded ideas equally. Asymmetry is retained as the chosen strict-priority semantics although irreflexivity plus transitivity suffices.
